title: Expose a typed per-obligation checkability advisory in work core inspect
outcome: Expose a typed per-obligation checkability advisory in work core inspect
acceptance: `work core inspect` reports, for each open obligation in its bounded page, a typed advisory derived from the existing completion classifier at the current claim/root cut that distinguishes checkable, not-checkable (displaced or waiver-only) and unknown, without a history scan.

The advisory grants no waiver authority and changes no satisfaction rule; existing fields and guidance are unchanged for consumers that ignore it, and a test covers a checkable open source-change obligation, a displaced one and a waiver-only one.
